title: Incident #4529 — Overnight Sales Report Shows Missing Data
scenario: The sales team noticed that the overnight sales report is missing entries for the last hour before the cutoff. Find the bug.

options.text: The time range is correct, but the query needs to include a filter for order_status.
The time range is excluding the last hour due to using a strict less-than operator.
The query should be using a LEFT JOIN to include all orders.
The order_time column is not indexed, causing performance issues.

explanation: The issue lies in the query's time range; it uses a strict less-than operator, which excludes orders made exactly at '2026-06-07 08:00:00'. Changing the condition to '<= '2026-06-07 08:00:00'' will include those orders in the results.
